execution.raw_text:
```sql
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_name,
  m.met_conversion,
  m.pathway_key
FROM metabolism m
INNER JOIN compound_records cr
  ON m.substrate_record_id = cr.record_id
INNER JOIN compound_structures cs
  ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno
ORDER BY
  cs.canonical_smiles ASC,
  cr.compound_name ASC,
  m.met_conversion ASC,
  m.pathway_key ASC
LIMIT 200
```
